name: contract-whist-score-tracker
description: Contract Whist score tracker web app with Android/iOS wrappers via Capacitor.

scripts.cap:assets:refresh:win: npm run brand:assets:win && npm run cap:assets
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
